dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So, in the end, The Captain still hasn't told us his real goal.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: He kind of reminds Paimon of someone we met recently... Oh, right! The Lord of the Night!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: They just seem so... tired, you know? Since they've both been alive for many centuries, do you think that's just what happens when you've been alive for too long...?
